disclaimer: A preview to help you choose. Colour and drape may look different on the real garment.
formats: JPG, PNG or WEBP, or a short video
hoverHint: Hover a piece to see its back
p1Body: A clear, full-length photo gives the clearest preview. No photo to hand? Try the house model.
p2Body: Pick one piece to see on you. You can try another after.
privacy: Your photo is sent to an outside AI service only to make this preview. We don’t keep it.
rackHoverHint: Hover a garment and it turns to show its back.
rackTapHint: Tap a garment to turn it. Swipe for more.
rackTitle: Turn an abaya on the rail
tapHint: Tap a piece to see its back
tips: Head to feet in the frame
Stand straight, arms a little away
title: Try it on with your photo
tryLink: Try it on with your photo
trySub: See this abaya on you, or on the house model
notFoundBody: The link may be old, or the piece may have left the collection.
pageNotFoundBody: The link may be old, or the page may have moved.
liveLoading: Getting ready to follow your shoulders…
liveHint: Stand back until your shoulders are in view
liveTracking: Move and turn — the abaya follows you
liveNoTracking: Tracking isn’t available here. Line yourself up with the abaya.
liveDenied: Camera access is off. Allow the camera for this site in your browser settings, then try again.
liveUnsupported: This browser can’t open the camera here. Choose a photo instead.
liveError: The camera didn’t start. Close other apps that use it, then try again.
liveNote: Tracking runs in your browser. Nothing is sent unless you choose Make it realistic.
liveNoteLocal: Tracking runs in your browser. Nothing is sent from the mirror.
liveAiBody: To dress you live, your camera video and the abaya’s picture are sent to {who}. Each session runs up to {n} seconds.
liveAiWhoBoth: Decart, our live try-on provider, or to fal.ai when Decart is unavailable
liveAiWhoFal: fal.ai, which runs Decart’s try-on model
liveAiKeepDecart: Under Decart’s privacy policy they may keep the video, with no set time limit unless you ask them to delete it, and use it to improve their service.
liveAiKeepFal: fal.ai’s privacy policy sets how long they keep the video.
liveAiEnded: Your live try-on time is up.
liveAiFailed: The live try-on couldn’t start or was cut off.
liveAiRate: You’ve used the live try-ons for now. Try again in an hour.
liveAiNote: While the live try-on runs, your camera video goes to {who}.
liveAiOff: The live try-on isn’t available right now. Use the on-device mirror instead.
freeDressing: A free public AI model is dressing you. It can take a minute or two, and when it is busy it may not answer.
liveNoteFree: Tracking runs in your browser. “Make it realistic” sends your picture to a free public AI model on Hugging Face, run by a third party that may keep it.
freeConsent: To make the preview, your photo is sent to a free public AI model on Hugging Face, run by a third party. We can’t control how long they keep it.
freeBusy: The free model is busy right now. Try again in a minute.
aiGreet: Hello, I’m Mazun’s AI stylist. I can choose an abaya for you, show it on you, find your size and suggest a set. What’s the occasion?
aiPlaceholder: E.g. a black abaya for a wedding
aiTryReply: To see the {name} on your own body, go to the fitting room: with a photo or the live mirror.
aiSizeAsk: How tall are you, and what size do you usually wear? I can also measure you with the camera.
aiSizeResult: {size} is the right size for you in {name}.
aiSetReply: For the {name}, I’d suggest this set: a shayla to match it, with a bag, jewellery and shoes {occasion}.
aiConfused: Tell me a little more: what occasion, which colour, or what budget?
aiNoneAvailable: Nothing in that size is in stock for this piece right now. Shall I find you another?
aiSizeFrom: From your height of {height} cm and usual size {usual}
aiSizeFromScan: From the camera: bust about {bust} cm
aiTall: At your height the hem sits a little above the ankle.
aiShort: At your height the hem falls a little longer.
aiAddLook: Add the whole set to bag
aiWearT: See it on your own body before you buy.
aiWearB: Send one photo and the AI shows the abaya on you. Or open the live mirror and move in front of the camera.
aiSizeT: Your size, without a tape measure.
aiSizeB: Tell us your height and stand in front of the camera. The AI measures your shoulders and hips and reads that piece’s own size chart. The result is an estimate, and the picture never leaves your device.
aiSetT: Choose the abaya. The rest of the set is ours.
aiSetB: Shayla, bag, jewellery and shoes, chosen for that abaya and that occasion, from what Mazun has in stock.
aiFact1: We tell you where your photo goes before it’s sent
aiScanIntro: Enter your height, lean your phone against something and step back until you are in the frame from head to feet.
aiScanPrivacy: The picture stays on this device and is not saved.
aiScanHeightBad: Enter a height between 130 and 210 cm.
aiScanNoone: Stand in front of the camera
aiScanBack: Step back so your head and feet are in the frame
aiScanFace: Face the camera and stand straight
aiScanNote: This is an estimate. If you are between two sizes, take the larger one.
aiScanFailed: The camera measurement isn’t available here. Answer a few questions instead.
aiWearSample: Illustrative image. Your result may differ
aiSizeNearest: {wanted} is sold out in {name}. The nearest size in stock is {size}. Shall I find you another piece?
aiNoBudget: We have nothing under {budget} rials. This is the closest.
aiNoColour: We don’t have that colour right now. This is the closest.
aiAfterTry: You’ve tried the {name}. Shall I find your size or complete the set?
sub: From ivory embroidery to midnight drape. Browse the collection, or ask Mazun’s AI stylist what to wear and in which size.
heroAltOlive: House model in an olive abaya with gold floral embroidery and a matching shayla
heroAltBlack: House model in a black abaya with gold beaded embroidery and a matching shayla
heroTryOn: Try an abaya on with your own photo
heroBothSides: Every abaya shown front and back
aiOnPiece: You’re looking at the {name}. Shall I find your size, complete the set or show it on you?
aiFabHint: Size, set or try-on? Just ask.
aiStartWith: Let’s start with the {name}. Tell me if you’d like another.
aiSetReplyPlain: For the {name}, I’d suggest this set: a shayla to match it, with a bag, jewellery and shoes.
aiAskOccasion: What’s the occasion? Pick one, or tell me a colour or a budget.
aiSetChange: You can change the occasion here.
aiPickUsual: Choose the size you usually wear.
aiSetChangeAi: You can change the occasion here, or tell me what you’d like different.
